prompt: Using the Q3 2024 balance sheet and income statement in the materials, compute Cipher Mining's net debt position (in thousands) as of September 30, 2024, defined as total interest-bearing financial liabilities (current and non-current finance lease liabilities only) minus unrestricted cash and cash equivalents. Exclude operating lease liabilities, the asset retirement obligation, deferred tax liabilities, and restricted cash.

Using the balance sheet and cash flow statement in the materials, compute Fathom Holdings' operating cash burn as a percentage of total revenue for the nine months ended September 30, 2024. Define operating cash burn as the absolute value of net cash used in operating activities for the nine months ended September 30, 2024, and total revenue as the nine-month total revenue from the income statement. Express as a percentage rounded to two decimal places.

Using the balance sheet and cash flow statement in the materials, compute Fathom Holdings' operating cash burn as a percentage of total revenue for the nine months ended September 30, 2024. Define operating cash burn as the absolute value of net cash used in operating activities for the nine months ended September 30, 2024, and total revenue as the nine-month total revenue from the income statement. Express as a percentage rounded to two decimal places.

Using the Statement of Changes in Stockholders' Deficit and the income statement in the materials, compute NRX Pharmaceuticals' implied standalone net loss for Q2 2024 (the three months ended June 30, 2024) as a percentage of the standalone Q3 2024 net loss (the three months ended September 30, 2024). Express as a percentage rounded to one decimal place.

Using the balance sheet at June 30, 2024 and December 31, 2023, compute Athira Pharma's net liquid asset burn rate expressed as an annualized percentage of the December 31, 2023 liquid asset base. Define liquid assets as cash and cash equivalents plus short-term investments (excluding all restricted cash). Annualize the six-month decline rate by multiplying by 2. Round to one decimal place.

Using the Statement of Changes in Stockholders' Deficit and the income statement in the materials, compute NRX Pharmaceuticals' implied standalone net loss for Q2 2024 (the three months ended June 30, 2024) as a percentage of the standalone Q3 2024 net loss (the three months ended September 30, 2024). Express as a percentage rounded to one decimal place.

Using the H1 2024 and Q2 2024 income statements in the materials, compute ProQR Therapeutics' implied standalone Q1 2024 (three months ended March 31, 2024) operating result, then compute the Q1 2024 operating margin (operating result divided by Q1 2024 revenue). Express as a percentage rounded to one decimal place. A negative percentage indicates an operating loss.

Using the balance sheet at June 30, 2024 and December 31, 2023, compute Athira Pharma's net liquid asset burn rate expressed as an annualized percentage of the December 31, 2023 liquid asset base. Define liquid assets as cash and cash equivalents plus short-term investments (excluding all restricted cash). Annualize the six-month decline rate by multiplying by 2. Round to one decimal place.
Compute Aclarion's current ratio as of September 30, 2024, rounded to two decimal places. Define current ratio as total current assets divided by total current liabilities.

Using the H1 2024 and Q2 2024 income statements in the materials, compute ProQR Therapeutics' implied standalone Q1 2024 (three months ended March 31, 2024) operating result, then compute the Q1 2024 operating margin (operating result divided by Q1 2024 revenue). Express as a percentage rounded to one decimal place. A negative percentage indicates an operating loss.

Compute ProQR Therapeutics' adjusted net liquidity position (in €thousands) as of June 30, 2024, defined as cash and cash equivalents plus current financial assets minus current-portion borrowings only. Do not include non-current borrowings or lease liabilities.

Using the balance sheet and income statement in the materials, compute HCWB's annualized operating leverage ratio as of Q3 2024. Define this as: annualized nine-month 2024 operating loss divided by annualized nine-month 2024 net revenues. Annualize by multiplying the nine-month figures by 4/3. Express the ratio as a positive number rounded to two decimal places (i.e., how many dollars of operating loss per dollar of net revenue).

Compute ProQR Therapeutics' adjusted net liquidity position (in €thousands) as of June 30, 2024, defined as cash and cash equivalents plus current financial assets minus current-portion borrowings only. Do not include non-current borrowings or lease liabilities.
Compute Aclarion's current ratio as of September 30, 2024, rounded to two decimal places. Define current ratio as total current assets divided by total current liabilities.
